minutes_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE BOARD OF SUPERVISORS
  ORANGE COUNTY, CALIFORNIA

  Tuesday, August 27, 2024,9 : 0 0 A . M .

  BOARD HEARING ROOM, FIRST FLOOR
  400 W. Civic Center Drive
  Santa Ana, California

  DONALD P. WAGNER
  CHAIRMAN
  Third District

 DOUG CHAFFEE  ANDREW DO
 VICE CHAIRMAN  SUPERVISOR
 Fourth District  First District

 VICENTE SARMIENTO  KATRINA
 SUPERVISOR  FOLEY
 Second District  SUPERVISOR
  Fifth District
ATTENDANCE:Supervisors Wagner, Chaffee, Sarmiento and Foley

EXCUSED:Supervisor Do

 PRESENT:  ACTING COUNTY EXECUTIVE  Michelle Aguirre
  OFFICER
  COUNTY COUNSEL  Leon J. Page
  CLERK OF THE BOARD  Robin Stieler

INVOCATION:Supervisor Foley, Fifth District, gave the invocation

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:Chairman Wagner, Third District, led the assembly in the Pledge of Allegiance

I.PRESENTATIONS/INTRODUCTIONS

 Chairman Wagner recognized the 2024 National Association of Counties Achievement Award Winners

 Vice Chairman Chaffee presented a resolution recognizing August 14, 2024 as "Pakistan Independence
 Day

 Supervisor Sarmiento will be presenting a resolution recognizing August 6, 2024 as "Bolivian
 Independence Day"
 DELETED

II.CONSENT CALENDAR (Items 1-12)
 52143  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED WITH THE EXCEPTION OF ITEM 10 WHICH
  X  WAS PULLED FOR DISCUSSION AND SEPARATE VOTE

BOARD APPOINTMENTS

1.  Supervisor Foley - Assessment Appeals Board No. 4 - Reappoint David C. Goldwasser,
  Costa Mesa, for term ending 9/5/27

  Chairman Wagner:

2.  Orange County HIV Planning Council - Appoint Roberta E. Cone, Newport Beach,
  Nsele M. Nsuangani, Sacramento and Karly Rubly, Laguna Niguel, for terms ending
  12/31/25

3.  Approve revised 2024 Chairman appointment to Orange County Housing Finance
  Trust

ELECTED DEPARTMENT HEADS

4.  Clerk-Recorder - Approve and consent to change in ownership structure of Extract Systems
  LLC to continue providing Auto-Indexing and Redaction Software and maintenance services
  pursuant to existing contract MA-059-22011525 - All Districts

5.  District Attorney - Adopt resolution approving FY 2023-24 Federal Equitable Sharing
  Agreement and Certification Report - All Districts
  RESO: 24-094

  Sheriff-Coroner:

6.  Approve lease agreement with State Department of Forestry and Fire Protection
  for intermittent, call-when-needed helicopter services, one-year term; and authorize
  Sheriff-Coroner or designee to execute lease agreement, related documents and
  subsequent agreements under certain conditions - All Districts

7.  Approve agreement 24112123 with State of California Commission on Peace
  Officer Standards and Training (POST) for coroner training courses, 9/1/24 - 6/30/25
  ($195,374); and authorize Sheriff-Coroner or designee to execute agreement - All
  Districts

8.  Approve agreement with City of Anaheim for reimbursement of the Hazardous
  Device Squad support during special events, 9/1/24 - 8/31/29; and authorize Sheriff-
  Coroner or designee to execute agreement - Districts 2, 3 and 4

CHILD SUPPORT SERVICES

9.  Approve FY 2024-25 Plan of Cooperation with California Department of Child Support
  Services for administration of Title IV-D Program services, 10/1/24 - 9/30/25, renewable for
  four additional one-year terms; and authorize Director or designee to execute Plan of
  Cooperation and renewals under certain conditions - All Districts

OC COMMUNITY RESOURCES
  10.  Acting as the Orange County Housing Authority - Authorize Executive Director or
  designee and Chairperson of the Board of Commissioners of the Orange County Housing
  Authority to sign Section 8 Management Assessment Program Certification for monitoring
  key areas of performance of Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher Program, FY 2023-24 and
  submit to U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development - All Districts
 42153  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED
  X

GENERAL ADMINISTRATION

  County Executive Office:

 11.  Acting as the Orange County Flood Control District - Approve Request for Proposals
  (RFP) to lease up to two segments of Orange County Flood Control property, City of
  Orange; authorize Chief Real Estate Officer or designee to issue RFP under certain
  conditions and negotiate Option and Lease and return to Board for final approval;
  adopt resolution finding proposed Orange County Flood Control District property is
  exempt surplus land pursuant to Surplus Land Act and other findings; and make
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) exemption findings under CEQA
  Guidelines Section 15301 - District 2
  RESO: 24-095

 12.  Approve Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Second Harvest Food Bank of
  Orange County for rent-free license of up to 125 parking spaces, 100 Acre Parcel,
  MCAS El Toro, Irvine, term ending 1/1/29; authorize Chief Real Estate Officer or
  designee to execute MOU and related documents and perform related actions under
  certain conditions; adopt resolution making findings pursuant to Government Code
  26227; and make California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) exemption findings
  under CEQA Guidelines Section 15301 - District 3
  RESO: 24-096
  END OF CONSENT CALENDAR

III.DISCUSSION ITEMS (Items 13-S22E)

HEALTH CARE AGENCY

 13.  Approve amendment 2 to Master Contract MA-042-23010987 and individual contracts with
  various providers of on-site psychiatry and telepsychiatry services, term ending 3/31/26
  ($830,000; cumulative aggregate total $23,503,660); and authorize County Procurement
  Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendments - District 2
 25143  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED
  X

 14.  Approve amendment 3 to Master Contract MA-042-22010436 and individual contracts with
  America On Track, Community Action Partnership of Orange County and OneOC for
  CalFresh Healthy Living services, 10/1/24 - 9/30/25 ($931,278; cumulative aggregate total
   $4,188,556); renewable for one additional one-year term; and authorize County Procurement
  Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendments - All Districts
25143  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED
  X

15.  Approve Master Contract MA-042-20011926 with various licensed clinical providers of
  professional services, 10/4/24 - 10/2/25 ($4,434,907); and authorize County Procurement
  Officer or Deputized designee to execute individual contracts - All Districts
25143  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED
  X

OC COMMUNITY RESOURCES

16.  Approve amendment 4 to contract MA-012-23010452 with Orange County's United Way
  dba Orange County United Way for CalFresh Expansion services, 10/1/24 - 9/30/25
  ($135,253; cumulative total $277,879); and authorize County Procurement Officer or
  Deputized designee to execute amendment and future amendments under certain conditions -
  All Districts
24153  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED
  X

OC PUBLIC WORKS

17.  Award contract MA-012-24011060 to C.W. Driver, LLC for pre-construction phase
  services ($186,193); approve model contract MA-012-24011666 with C.W. Driver, LLC for
  construction phase services ($14,298,807) for Garden Grove and La Habra Libraries Project;
  authorize Director or designee to execute contracts; and make California Environmental
  Quality Act (CEQA) Class 2 exemption findings under CEQA Guidelines section 15302 -
  Districts 1 and 4
43125  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED
  X

PUBLIC PROTECTION

  Probation:

18.  Approve amendment 1 to contract MA-057-22011675 with Universal Protection
  Service, LP dba Allied Universal Security Services for security guard services,
  10/1/24 - 9/30/25 ($1,300,000; cumulative total $4,055,000); renewable for one
  additional one-year term; and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized
  designee to exercise cost contingency increase not to exceed 10% under certain
  conditions and execute amendment - Districts 1, 2 and 5
24153  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED
  X

19.  Approve amendment 7 to contract MA-057-21010069 with Redwood Toxicology
  Laboratory, Inc. for drugs and alcohol screening products and services, 10/1/24 -
  9/30/25 ($3,000,000; cumulative total $11,152,669); and authorize County
  Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendment - All Districts
52143  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED
  X
 SOCIAL SERVICES AGENCY

20.  Approve amendment 3 to agreement WGM0719-A3 with Access California Services for
  refugee social services, 10/1/24 - 9/30/25 ($690,530; cumulative total $4,119,268); and
  authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to make future non-material
  changes under certain conditions and execute amendment - All Districts
B.O.  CONTINUED TO 9/10/24, 9:30 A.M.

GENERAL ADMINISTRATION

  County Executive Office:

21.  Approve recommended positions on introduced or amended legislation and/or
  consider other legislative subject matters - All Districts
54123  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED
  XX

22.  Approve grant applications/awards submitted by Health Care Agency, OC
  Community Resources, District Attorney, OC Public Works and Sheriff-Coroner in
  8/27/24 grant report and other actions as recommended; adopt resolutions authorizing
  District Attorney or designee to execute grant award agreements with California
  Department of Insurance for Disability and Healthcare Insurance Fraud Program
  ($1,095,984), Life and Annuity Consumer Protection Program ($116,906), and
  Workers' Compensation Insurance Fraud Program ($8,553,472), 7/1/24 - 6/30/25; and
  making California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) exemption findings pursuant
  to CEQA Guidelines Section 15061(b)(3) and other findings - All Districts
54123  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED
  X
  RESO: 24-097 - 24-099

S22A.  Chairman Wagner - North Tustin Advisory Committee - Reappoint John (Pat) Welsh,
  Santa Ana, for term ending 3/31/26
32145  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED
  X

S22B.  Supervisor Foley - Approve addition of Olympian Parade, Dana Point Harbor, to County
  Master Events Calendar; and make related findings per Government Code Section 26227
52143  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED
  X

S22C.  County Executive Office - Approve amendment 2 to lease agreement, revised Offer to
  Convey and revised Purchase and Sale Agreement with Centurion Partners Santa Ana, LLC
  for 1928 South Grand Avenue, Santa Ana ($100); authorize Chief Real Estate Officer or
  designee to execute amendments and related documents under certain conditions; authorize
  additional expenditure ($50,000; new total $400,000) for due diligence and other related
  costs; direct Auditor-Controller to make related payments; and make California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) exemption findings under CEQA Guidelines 15301 -
  District 2
24153  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED
  X
 ELECTED DEPARTMENT HEADS

  Sheriff-Coroner:

 S22D.  Adopt resolution approving form of Facility Sublease with State Department of
  Corrections and Rehabilitation, designating Chair of the Board of Supervisors,
  County Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer, Sheriff-Coroner and Sheriff-
  Coroner's Executive Director or their interim or designees as Authorized Officers to
  execute the Facility Sublease, related documents, amendments and agreements and
  carry out related actions for execution of sublease and issuance of bonds for James A.
  Musick Facility (AB 900 and SB 1022) project - Districts 3 and 5
 35124  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED
  X
  RESO: 24-100

 S22E.  Approve FY 2023-24 Federal Equitable Sharing Agreement and Certification for
  federally forfeited property or proceeds received for Sheriff-Coroner Department - All
  Districts
 54123  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED
  X

IV.PUBLIC HEARINGS (Item 23)

ELECTED DEPARTMENT HEADS

 23.  District Attorney and Clerk-Recorder - Public Hearing to consider approving District
  Attorney Real Estate Fraud Prosecution Annual Report, FY 2023-24; adopting resolution
  approving increase to real estate fraud protection fee collected by Orange County Clerk-
  Recorder from $3 to $8 on certain specified real estate instruments, 10/1/24 - 9/30/27;
  rescinding Resolution No. 24-017; and make California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  exemption findings under Public Resources Code 21080(b)(8) and CEQA guidelines Section
  15273 and other findings - All Districts
 B.O.  DELETED

V.CLOSED SESSION

GENERAL ADMINISTRATION

  County Executive Office:

 SCS1.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE APPOINTMENT - Pursuant to Government Code Section
  54957(b):
  Title: County Executive Officer
 B.O.  HELD, NO REPORTABLE ACTION

 SCS2.  CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR - Pursuant to Government Code
  Section 54957.6:
  Agency Negotiator:Jeff Griffin, Acting Chief Human Resources Officer
  Unrepresented Employee:County Executive Officer
 B.O.  HELD, NO REPORTABLE ACTION
   County Counsel:

SCS3.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION - Pursuant
  to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1):
  Name of Case: Marcus Rodriguez III et al. v. County of Orange, et al., United States
  District Court Case No. 3:23-cv-00823-W-DDL
B.O.  COUNTY COUNSEL READ: ON A VOTE OF 4-0, WITH SUPERVISOR DO
  ABSENT, THE BOARD APPROVED THE DELEGATION OF LIMITED
  SETTLEMENT AUTHORITY TO RISK MANAGEMENT TO RESOLVE
  THE MATTER OF MARCUS RODRIGUEZ III ET AL V. COUNTY OF
  ORANGE, A CASE THAT INVOLVES ALLEGATIONS OF FALSE ARREST,
  EXCESSIVE FORCE, AND CIVIL RIGHTS VIOLATIONS ON THE PART
  OF DEPUTY SHERIFF PERSONNEL WHO WERE INVESTIGATING
  CRIMES ALLEGEDLY COMMITTED BY PLAINTIFF'S SON.

SCS4.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION - Pursuant
  to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1):
  Name of Case: Peter Cunningham v. County of Orange, et al., San Bernardino
  Superior Court Case No. CIVSB2126796
B.O.  COUNTY COUNSEL READ: ON A VOTE OF 4-0, WITH SUPERVISOR DO
  ABSENT, THE BOARD APPROVED THE DELEGATION OF LIMITED
  SETTLEMENT AUTHORITY TO RISK MANAGEMENT IN THE MATTER
  OF PETER CUNNINGHAM V. COUNTY OF ORANGE, A MATTER THAT
  INVOLVES AN AUTOMOBILE ACCIDENT AND AN ALLEGED
  DANGEROUS CONDITION ON LIVE OAK CANYON ROAD IN TRABUCO
  CANYON.

SCS5.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION - Pursuant
  to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1):
  Name of Case: Syed Raza Hussain v. County of Orange, United States District Court
  Case No. 8:22-cv-02100
B.O.  COUNTY COUNSEL READ: ON A VOTE OF 4-0, WITH SUPERVISOR DO
  ABSENT, THE BOARD APPROVED A PROPOSED $1,050,000
  SETTLEMENT IN THE MATTER OF SYED RAZA HUSSAIN V. COUNTY
  OF ORANGE. IN THIS CASE INVOLVING AN OFFICER-INVOLVED
  SHOOTING, PLAINTIFF ALLEGES UNLAWFUL SEARCH AND SEIZURE,
  UNLAWFUL DETENTION AND ARREST, AND STATE LAW CLAIMS FOR
  BATTERY, NEGLIGENCE, AND VIOLATIONS OF THE BANE ACT IN
  CONNECTION WITH LAW ENFORCEMENT'S RESPONSE TO A 911
  CALL CONCERNING A DOMESTIC DISPUTE IN PLAINTIFF'S HOME.
  THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT REQUIRES THE FINAL APPROVAL
  OF OTHERS. WHEN THE SETTLEMENT IS FINALIZED, COPIES OF THE
  SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT WILL BE MADE AVAILABLE THROUGH
  THE OFFICE OF CEO-RISK MANAGEMENT TO ANY PERSON WHO
  INQUIRES.

SCS6.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION - Pursuant
  to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1):
  Name of Case: Stewart Rawlings v. County of Orange, WCAB Cases: ADJ15172159;
  ADJ12664596; ADJ564936
 B.O.  COUNTY COUNSEL READ: ON A VOTE OF 4-0, WITH SUPERVISOR DO
  ABSENT, THE BOARD APPROVED A PROPOSED $244,858.50
  SETTLEMENT IN THE MATTER OF STEWART RAWLINGS V. COUNTY
  OF ORANGE. IN THIS WORKERS' COMPENSATION CASE, THE
  APPLICANT IS AN ORANGE COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT
  SERGEANT WHO RETIRED AFTER 30 YEARS OF SERVICE, AND
  ALLEGED CUMULATIVE TRAUMA TO HIS BACK, RIGHT SHOULDER,
  AND CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM. THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT
  REQUIRES THE FINAL APPROVAL OF OTHERS. WHEN THE
  SETTLEMENT IS FINALIZED, COPIES OF THE SETTLEMENT
  AGREEMENT WILL BE MADE AVAILABLE THROUGH THE OFFICE OF
  CEO-RISK MANAGEMENT TO ANY PERSON WHO INQUIRES.

SCS7.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION - Pursuant
  to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1):
  Name of Case: Orange County Catholic Worker, et al. v. County of Orange, et al.,
  United States District Court Case No. 8:18-cv-00155-DOC-(JDEx). David Ramirez,
  et at. v. County of Orange, United States District Court Case No. 8:18-cv-0220-DOC-
  (KESx)
B.O.  HELD, NO REPORTABLE ACTION

.  COUNTY COUNSEL READ: WITH RESPECT TO THE MATTER OF DAMON
  TUCKER V. COUNTY OF ORANGE, ORANGE COUNTY CASE NO. 30-2021-
  01200119, THE PLAINTIFF IN THIS EMPLOYMENT CASE, A DISTRICT
  ATTORNEY INVESTIGATOR, HAS REPORTEDLY ACCEPTED THE BOARD'S
  COUNTEROFFER, WHICH HAD BEEN APPROVED BY THE BOARD, ON A
  VOTE OF 3 TO 0, WITH CHAIRMAN WAGNER AND SUPERVISOR DO ABSENT,
  AS PART OF CS-1 ON JULY 23, 2024. THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT WILL
  REQUIRE THE FINAL APPROVAL OF OTHERS. WHEN THE SETTLEMENT
  AGREEMENT IS FINALIZED, COPIES OF THE SETTLEMENT WILL BE MADE
  AVAILABLE THROUGH THE OFFICE OF CEO-RISK MANAGEMENT TO ANY
  PERSON WHO INQUIRES.

VI.PUBLIC, CEO, ADJOURNMENT & BOARD COMMENTS

PUBLIC COMMENTS:

Steve Rocco - Oral Re: Received property tax bill with penalties attached and appealed penalty;
running for public office and has the same enemies as Trump including Chapman University;
monopoly on crime and can kill anybody you want through consolidation; number of words allowed
under his name on ballot is different than others; selling advertising in Registrar of Voter pamphlets
mailed to registered voters; election fraud and Bob Page; Pakistani Day and killing of children in
England; assassination on Trump

Carol Graves - Oral Re: Jurisdiction of the horses and animal cruelty by the Orange County
Fairgrounds CEO, Michelle Richards and her staff at the OC Fairgrounds; horses have not been able to
exercise which has led to dangerous situation for the horses, handlers and riders; advocate for horses
because they helped her child who is autistic; horses should not be pawns in a contract dispute and
receive exercise per codes and regulations of stalled animals; requested Board intervene, change the
situation and have safety restored for horses, children and handlers
  Mark Richard Daniels - Oral Re: Requested Supervisor Do resign from office

 Paul Hyek - Oral Re: Recycling symbol displayed on some products but not others; Ventura County
 requires eBike vendors to have a M1 license by the Department of Motors Vehicles and cannot be
 purchased by anyone under the age of 18

 Jeff Weaver - Oral Re: Biofuel farm project for landfill at Prima Deshecha

 Richard Larsen - Oral Re: Concerns with those advocates against Orange County's election system are
 without merit; recommended not changing Orange County's voting system

 Jackie Cordova - Oral Re: Resident of Santa Ana; Supervisor Do and use of children as a political
 ploy; misuse of COVID relief funds; We the People filed a formal complaint against the County of
 Orange, Frank Kim, Bob Page, Registrar of Voters and the Board of Supervisors; Anaheim business
 leader probe in corruption of COVID testing money

 Name not provided - Oral Re: Dr. Douglas Frank's analysis of voter rolls; requested to schedule time to
 review evidence regarding massive voter fraud in California and the unreliability of voting machines;
 return to one day voting with paper ballots, no machines, proof of citizenship, identification,
 signatures, hand counts and totals produced and verified at the precinct level

 Kate - Oral Re: Election fraud and certification of the 2020, 2021 Newsom recall and 2022 elections;
 Kamala Harris was appointed and not voted in by constituents for the 2024 election

 Mary - Oral Re: Multiple issues and laws have been ignored after numerous requests for the Board to
 host a special meeting; active lawsuits regarding elections; get rid of the Voters Choice Act, require
 proof of citizenship and voting precincts; meeting regarding lithium battery plant storage

 Bryan Kaye - Oral Re: Petitions and forged criminal plea agreement; criminal defense attorney Rene
 Garcia committed fraud on the court by recommending psychiatric evaluation

 Gibran Stout - Oral Re: Criminal neglect and abuse of horses at OC Fairgrounds; OC Animal Care is
 responsible for enforcing all local, state and federal laws; abuse of animals is criminal and a solution is
 needed

 Cheryl - Oral Re: Misinformation about whether or not Bob Page and the Registrar of Voters has been
 alerted to the concerns of elections; State is not allowing Orange County to ensure free and fair
 elections; requested meeting to discuss issues and concerns regarding voting system; stop providing
 discretionary funds until audits are conducted

COUNTY EXECUTIVE OFFICER COMMENTS:

 Michelle Aguirre - Oral Re: Accepting public comments for the 2024 Strategic Financial Plan on the
 County's website through August 30, 2024

ADJOURNED:1:11 P.M.

BOARD COMMENTS:

 Vice Chairman Chaffee - Oral Re: Metrolink is offering a $10 Holiday Pass on Labor Day
   Supervisor Sarmiento - Oral Re: In-person townhall on August 28 at Grijalva Park in the City of
  Orange to discuss the County's Fiscal Year 2024-2025 budget; County budget staff will present
  information and answer questions; investigation that has been opened against Viet American Society
  that the County does business with which is unsettling for the public and County staff; demanded
  Supervisor Do step down from office; requested the Board censure Supervisor Do

  Supervisor Foley - Oral Re: Hosting General Plan Update Workshop tonight at the Muth Center in
  Back Bay, Newport Beach; hosting an Orange County Public Works Active Transportation
  Community Open House on August 28 at the Muth Center in Back Bay, Newport Beach; hosting
  Olympian Parade at Dana Point Harbor on September 8; announced the International Irish Step
  Dancing Day Showcase at the William R. Mason Regional Park on September 17; called on Supervisor
  Andrew Do to immediately resign from the Board of Supervisors; will pursue all legal avenues to have
  Supervisor Do removed if he does not resign; agenda item to remove Supervisor Do from all
  board/Chairman committee assignments on September 10; thanked County staff during this time,
  advised them that they are supported and will not be put in harms way, do not have to fear reaching out
  would cause any concern for their position and can report any lapses in integrity by calling our Fraud
  Hotline at 714-834-3608.
